The fungus features a complex, multi-branched structure arising from a central base, with numerous upright, cylindrical branches that divide into finer, club-shaped tips. The texture appears smooth and matte. The background consists of blurred brown leaf litter, twigs, and sparse green grass blades, indicating a natural woodland habitat.
